Principal – Architecture & Regional Growth
Atlanta, GA | $180,000 Base + Equity Partnership + Aggressive Commissions
An innovative, technology-driven architecture and development platform is seeking an entrepreneurial Principal to spearhead its expansion throughout Atlanta and the Southeast.
This is a rare opportunity for an established architect who has built a strong reputation within the development community and is ready to leverage those relationships to create something of their own.
We are looking for a commercially minded leader who sees opportunity beyond the traditional practice of architecture—someone who understands how developments are conceived, financed, designed, approved, and delivered, and who can translate that knowledge into meaningful business growth.
The successful candidate will have the autonomy to establish a significant regional presence, supported by an innovative platform that is embracing AI to advance the way architecture and development projects are approached.
The Opportunity
Establish and grow a regional architectural practice serving leading residential and mixed-use developers throughout Atlanta and the Southeast.
Capitalize on an established network of developer relationships to originate new projects and generate substantial architectural fee revenue.
Develop long-term partnerships with developers, ownership groups, investors, and other influential industry stakeholders.
Provide strategic leadership from early development feasibility and project positioning through design and execution.
Represent the firm at the highest levels, leading presentations, negotiations, and major project pursuits.
Help shape the regional growth strategy while championing the use of AI-driven technology to improve design and development outcomes.
Ideal Background
15+ years of progressive architectural experience, including substantial Principal, Partner, or senior leadership responsibilities.
Currently based in Atlanta, with deep relationships throughout the local and regional development community.
Extensive portfolio of significant multifamily residential and mixed-use projects.
Documented success originating new business, securing commissions, and expanding developer relationships.
Comprehensive understanding of the development lifecycle, including design, entitlement, feasibility, project economics, and execution.
Exceptional presentation skills, executive presence, and ability to influence sophisticated clients and decision-makers.
Entrepreneurial, ambitious, and motivated by the opportunity to build and lead a growing business.
Strong appreciation for the role artificial intelligence can play in improving architectural practice and real estate development.
Compensation & Long-Term Opportunity
$180,000 Base Salary + Equity Partnership Opportunity + Highly Aggressive New Business Commissions
Beyond a competitive base salary, this position offers meaningful financial participation in the growth and success of the regional practice.
We are seeking a leader who wants to build more than a portfolio of projects—someone interested in creating lasting business value, developing influential relationships, and participating directly in the success they generate.
Local Atlanta candidates only.
If interested, please apply directly to Dan Cloke at [email protected].
